timing_of_design: Companion protocol for all ten tasks already registered in f441c21. Frozen after source acquisition and before inspecting predictive results or any outer outcomes. Previous PMLB/Optdigits results are known. The four primary transport policies and outcomes stay as registered.
question: Does actually fitting a small model on each candidate improve single-candidate nomination? How often is successful half-width compression possible on these slates even in hindsight?
low_fidelity: Use the exact same anchor, proposal pool, fit/proposal/guard/development samples, metric tolerances and Gain tie-break as the primary transport test. Fit an 8-boosting-round XGB classifier to each retained subset and the anchor on the original fitting rows only (same eta, max_depth, seed and single CPU thread as the 100-round learner). Score each on the unweighted full proposal rows and choose the candidate with best worst normalized joint metric slack against the 8-round anchor. Only this nominee gets a genuine 100-round candidate guard check alongside the anchor. Final learner remains the 100-round XGB fit on all development rows. This is a low-fidelity refit control, not a reproduction of a warm-start estimator. One prespecified fidelity; do not select boosting rounds after observing results.
cost: Count every additional 8-round fit. Report per-fold low-fidelity screen seconds from imputation and reduced model training through proposal-row scores. This component cannot establish an end-to-end speed advantage. Benchmark-only complete-slate guard and outer fits are excluded from deployable fit counts. Skip nomination for singleton anchors.
evaluation: For the entire fixed slate also compute both full guard probabilities and full outer probabilities per support. In a fit stage that never reads targets.npz, seal every fold's entire predictions and the low-fidelity nomination. Read outer targets only in a separate scorer after all 30 seals. Reuse exact fixed vote/gain nominations from the separate primary experiment without outer information. Report companion U, AUC/accuracy, breaches versus Gain, paired equal-task U interval, fixed-slate oracle dispositions as in refit_opportunity. Primary cohort untouched; these are secondary decisions. Keep nulls and infeasible outcomes. Hindsight ceilings are descriptive bounds on observed outcomes and have no deployment interpretation.
